name: Laravel
server: Nginx with PHP-FPM, as in Laravel's deployment documentation
workers: Nginx: BENCH_WORKERS (2) workers; PHP-FPM: pm = static with pm.max_children = DB_POOL_SIZE (16) processes
database_layer: Eloquent (pdo_pgsql); one connection per PHP-FPM process, opened for each request (at most 16)
logging: none (Nginx and PHP-FPM access logs off; Laravel logs warnings and errors to stderr)
notes: php artisan optimize runs at start-up; the HTML page uses the web middleware group with the cookie session driver.
